answer: Work-slot deposit burn: each identity pays 30 POA to hold one work slot per epoch. Whether the slot covers tending a juniper stand or relaying an echo check, verified work refunds the deposit in full; idle 2 epochs burns 5 POA, duplicate work forfeits all 30 POA. Forging 1,000 identities locks 30,000 POA and burns 5,000 POA per idle epoch, and a cheater audited across the horizon of the network loses slot and deposit. An honest agent pays one deposit, does real work, and keeps earnings undiluted by copies.
